I'll group ICI drugs into pharmacological classes and define an irAE outcome set (endocrine, GI/colitis, hepatitis, pneumonitis, dermatitis, nephritis, etc.). Let me first assign each patient's first ICI class.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Map ICI descendant drug_concept_ids back to their ingredient/class, and find first ICI per patient
WITH mel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4162276
),
ici_map AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_id, ca.ancestor_concept_id AS ing_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (42629079,1593273,35200783,1594034,40238188,45892628,45775965,741851,36860767)
),
exp AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, m.ing_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS sdate
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ici_map m ON de.drug_concept_id = m.drug_id
  JOIN mel ON de.person_id = mel.person_id
),
first_ici AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(sdate) AS first_date
  FROM exp GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (45775965,45892628,35200783) THEN 'Anti-PD-1'
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (42629079,1594034,1593273) THEN 'Anti-PD-L1'
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (40238188,741851,36860767) THEN 'Anti-CTLA-4'
  END AS drug_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM exp e
JOIN first_ici f ON e.person_id = f.person_id AND e.sdate = f.first_date
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (45775965,45892628,35200783) THEN 'Anti-PD-1'
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (42629079,1594034,1593273) THEN 'Anti-PD-L1'
    WHEN e.ing_id IN (40238188,741851,36860767) THEN 'Anti-CTLA-4'
  END
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;

    END AS drug_class,
    de.drug_exposure_start_date AS sdate
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ici_map m ON de.drug_concept_id = m.drug_id
  JOIN mel ON de.person_id = mel.person_id
),

  SELECT person_id, drug_class, sdate AS index_date
  FROM (

    FROM exp

),
irae_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS cid
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN
    (4272488,4291025,73001,133444,138502,140673,193253,4129537,4142479,253506,314383,4028363,

),

  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
  JOIN irae_concepts ic ON co.condition_concept_id = ic.cid
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > c.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, c.index_date)
)
SELECT c.drug_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) AS n_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS n_with_irae,
  CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT e.person_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_irae
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN irae_events e ON c.person_id = e.person_id
GROUP BY c.drug_class
ORDER BY pct_irae DESC;

  ) anc
),
irae_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS cid, cat.category
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN cat ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = cat.cid
),
events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.drug_class, c.person_id, im.category
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
  JOIN irae_map im ON co.condition_concept_id = im.cid
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > c.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
)
SELECT drug_class, category, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS n_pts
FROM events
GROUP BY drug_class, category
ORDER BY drug_class, n_pts DESC;

The organ-system breakdown confirms the signal is real and distributed across canonical irAE systems (thyroid, colitis, hypophysitis, pneumonitis) rather than driven by one code. Here's the answer.

## Yes — irAE rates differ by ICI class, in the expected direction

Melanoma patients (SNOMED *Malignant melanoma* + descendants) with a first ICI exposure, immune-related adverse events counted within 365 days of that first dose:

| First ICI class | Patients | ≥1 irAE in 12 mo | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Anti-CTLA-4** (ipilimumab, tremelimumab) | 119 | 65 | **54.6%** |
| **Anti-PD-1** (pembrolizumab, nivolumab, cemiplimab) | 1,182 | 575 | **48.6%** |
| **Anti-PD-L1** (atezolizumab, durvalumab, avelumab) | 25 | 11 | **44.0%** |

**Anti-CTLA-4 ≈ 54.6% > anti-PD-1 ≈ 48.6% > anti-PD-L1 ≈ 44.0%** — the same ordering reported in the ICI literature (CTLA-4 blockade being the most toxic class). The organ-system pattern is also textbook: thyroid dysfunction, colitis, pneumonitis, arthritis, and hypophysitis dominate, with hypophysitis/adrenal notably enriched in the anti-CTLA-4 arm (15/119 ≈ 13% vs 31/1182 ≈ 3% for anti-PD-1).

## Important caveats before over-reading this

- **Anti-PD-L1 n = 25** — the 44% is on a tiny denominator; that arm's estimate is unstable and the CI would be wide. Atezolizumab/durvalumab/avelumab are not standard first-line melanoma agents, so these are likely off-label or later-line.
- **Class is assigned by *first* ICI only.** Many melanoma patients receive **combination ipi+nivo**; a same-day ipilimumab + nivolumab start is counted here as anti-CTLA-4 (or ties broken arbitrarily), which inflates the anti-CTLA-4 arm's rate since combination therapy is the most toxic regimen of all. A cleaner analysis would model a separate *combination* group.
- **Association, not adjusted.** These are crude rates — no adjustment for age, stage, line of therapy, or follow-up time, and no formal test. Sicker/combination patients self-select into anti-CTLA-4.
- **Prevalent vs incident irAEs.** I required onset *after* the index date, but conditions like hypothyroidism can be pre-existing and re-coded; a true incident analysis would exclude patients with the diagnosis before index.
- **Coding-based outcome.** irAEs are proxied by condition codes (not attributed causally to the drug), so both false positives (background disease) and false negatives (under-coding) exist.

Bottom line: **directionally yes and consistent with known pharmacology, but the difference is modest, unadjusted, and confounded by combination therapy — treat it as hypothesis-generating, not a definitive class comparison.** Want me to (a) break out an explicit ipi+nivo combination group, (b) add exact 95% CIs and a chi-square/Fisher test, or (c) restrict to incident irAEs (no prior diagnosis)?
